entities.name: Query bHLH transcription factor
observations: The 652-aa query sequence exactly matches UniProt E3SXU4 from Pisum sativum; identity and coverage are 100%.
Predicted Pfam domains include bHLH-MYC_N at residues 13-195, HLH at 467-514, bHLH_IRO3 at 471-529, and a plant bHLH transcription-factor domain at 569-647.
Sequence-derived molecular mass is approximately 72.96 kDa and theoretical pI is 4.99; these are unmodified-protein estimates.

entities.name: E3SXU4
observations: Reviewed Pisum sativum basic helix-loop-helix protein A.
Annotated as a transcription activator involved in control of flavonoid pigmentation.
Annotated localization is nucleus and molecular function includes protein dimerization activity.

entities.name: BHLH42
observations: Actinidia chinensis BHLH42 is a close homolog with 61.1% identity over 97.7% query coverage.
BHLH42 activates anthocyanin-biosynthetic genes LDOX/ANS and F3GT1 with MYB123 and is localized to the nucleus.

entities.name: Arabidopsis TT8
observations: Arabidopsis thaliana TT8 is a 44.3%-identity homolog over 97.9% query coverage.
TT8 is a nuclear bHLH transcription activator involved in flavonoid, anthocyanin, and proanthocyanidin biosynthetic regulation and interacts with MYB transcription factors.
